crossRefs.note: Joab sent to Tekoa, and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on…
Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful…
David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself…
There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks…

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’ ”
translations.bsb: a wise woman called out from the city, “Listen! Listen! Please tell Joab to come here so that I may speak with him.”
translations.kjv: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
translations.asv: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
